messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need runtime metrics added to the dashboard (per-request CPU/GPU, queue_ms, kernel_ms) and to decide RBAC/sharing for internal vs customer-facing views. Who owns the access model for these views?

maria: I can own the RBAC model. Need infra inputs though — what telemetry fields will be available? e.g. model_id, region, route, customer_id, request_tags?

jordan: We already emit `host_gpu_util`, `kernel_ms`, `queue_ms`, `tokens_generated`. I can add `request_owner` and a `view_scope` field to events.

lee: Important constraint: customer-facing dashboards must never leak hostnames or raw host ids. All host_* fields should be aggregated or removed for tenant views. Pseudonymize if needed.

sam: Compliance + Support flagged auditability: any share action needs an immutable audit event (who shared, scope, resource, timestamp).

maria: Proposed view scopes: `org_admin`, `team_member`, `tenant_view`, `public_link`. Mapping idea: each scope applies a visibility filter in the query layer (column-level or aggregated). Thoughts?

alex: That mapping looks fine. For rollout: put the sharing UI behind feature flag `rbac-dashboard-shares` and canary to ~10% of orgs. Console UX should show a clear confirmation when sharing with customers.

jordan: On telemetry changes: I'll add `view_scope` enum and a `share_event` type to the event stream. Sample event payload we can standardize on: `{"actor":"<id>", "action":"share", "resource_type":"dashboard", "resource_id":"<id>", "scope":"tenant_view", "timestamp":<ts>}`

lee: Also recommend retention defaults: audit logs 1 year, telemetry 90 days, with export option for Private deployments (S3 export).

ops-bot: :warning: Heads-up — schema changes may break existing saved queries/dashboards. Add migration steps and compatibility tests.

maria: I'll open a draft PR `platform/rbac/dashboard-sharing` that includes schema changes, policy mapping table, UI strings, and a short migration plan. Assigning reviewers: @jordan @lee @alex. Target: PR by EOD tomorrow.

alex: :thumbsup: Please include a short explainer doc for PMs and Support so they can field customer questions, and a sample ACL matrix.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: schema-migrations/2026-03-20 applied to staging (build #4267).

jordan: I'll add the new metric queries to `infra-observability` dashboards and mark which panels are safe for tenant exposure (aggregated only).

sam: One more ask: add an audit API endpoint `/api/v1/audit/logs` with query params `resource_id`, `actor`, `since`; restrict to org_admins and add export CSV option.

maria: Noted. Will add API contract to PR. Thanks everyone — I'll sync with Legal on wording for customer-facing warnings and then post the RFC link here.
